modules.name: AI Virus Defender
modules.desc: Defender-style lightweight real-time protection with staged detectors, resource-aware background monitoring, queued scans, and AI investigation only for suspicious activity. Heuristic AI scanner v3. Process scan: name spoof, parent-chain validation, hidden PIDs. Memory scan: RWX unbacked regions, injected MZ headers, DLL injection, process hollowing (PE timestamp mismatch). Persistence: registry Run keys, startup folders, scheduled tasks, WMI subscriptions, services, IFEO hijacks, AppInit_DLLs. Filesystem: threaded deep-scan with YARA-style patterns, per-section entropy, overlay detection, Authenticode check. Quarantine: AES-256-CBC encrypted with HMAC integrity, restore/purge, manifest. Self-protection: DACL process guard + scheduled-task watchdog relaunch. Settings: in-UI config editor persisted to JSON, hot-applied without restart.
